name: workspace-vm
description: A plain Debian 13 workspace virtual machine from the public images server (images.linuxcontainers.org): 2 CPUs, 4GiB of memory and a 20GiB root disk on the node's pool, with one NIC. On a node with the managed service network it gets an address from Arca's network; with a bridge named, it joins that host bridge and gets its address from the bridge's own network.
